ball_clearance_contract.description: Smallest positive directed native-frame offset beyond the final collision region whose integer runtime ball center overlaps at most 3% alpha with the player for every authored ball rotation.
ball_clearance_contract.monotonic_description: Kick frames store the directed prefix maximum of clearance so the pre-contact ball cannot reverse; any residual contact difference bounds a gradual player-root advance into the contact pose.
ball_clearance_contract.run_approach_description: Each compatible run-entry frame stores the maximum clearance from its four preceding frames and itself; the selected entry supplies one fixed handoff floor.
ball_clearance_contract.runtime_scale_reference: median visible_bbox height of the run frames for each uniform and direction
ball_clearance_contract.search_order: nearest positive directed center after the final unsafe center
